title: Fix Rupee price decimal display and change 'Shop on Amazon' button to soft pink

requirements.text: Fix the Rupee price display in the ProductGrid component (and any other product card/listing components) so that prices are correctly formatted with decimals. Prices stored as integers (e.g., 139900 representing paise) must be divided by 100 and displayed with 2 decimal places using the Indian Rupee symbol (e.g., Rs.1,399.00). Ensure this fix is applied consistently wherever product prices are rendered across the application.

quotes: Amount of every products used in Rupee Symbol without any Decimal. i.e. Rs.1399.00 is showing 139900. Use decimals for Rupees on every product.

acceptanceCriteria: All product prices display with 2 decimal places (e.g., Rs.1,399.00 instead of 139900)
The Rupee symbol (Rs. or ₹) is shown before the price on every product card
Price formatting is consistent across ProductGrid, product cards, and any other product display components
No other product data fields are affected by this change

requirements.text: Change the 'Shop on Amazon' button color to soft pink for every product card in the ProductGrid component and any other location where this button appears. Use a soft/light pink color (e.g., bg-pink-300 or similar Tailwind soft pink shade) for the button background, ensuring readable text contrast and hover state consistency.

quotes: "Shop on Amazon" button change color to soft Pink for every product.

acceptanceCriteria: Every 'Shop on Amazon' button across all product cards is styled with a soft pink background color
Button text remains legible against the soft pink background
A hover state is applied that slightly darkens or adjusts the pink shade for visual feedback
No other buttons or UI elements are inadvertently affected

constraints: Do not change any backend data storage or schema — price values are stored as-is; only the frontend display formatting should change
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
Keep all other product card styles, layout, and functionality unchanged
nonGoals: Changing how prices are stored in the backend
Modifying any other button colors or UI elements beyond 'Shop on Amazon'
Adding new product fields or changing product data structure
Modifying admin panel product management forms
